concepts.name: Turing Test (Imitation Game)
concepts.summary: Operational test of a machine's ability to exhibit intelligent behavior indistinguishable from that of a human.

concepts.name: Artificial Intelligence
concepts.summary: The field of computer science dedicated to creating systems capable of performing tasks requiring human intelligence.

concepts.name: Perceptron
concepts.summary: Early artificial neuron algorithm for binary classification utilizing linear threshold units.

concepts.name: Backpropagation
concepts.summary: Algorithm for efficiently computing gradient of loss function with respect to weights in multi-layer neural networks.

concepts.name: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
concepts.summary: Feedforward neural architecture using convolution filters and spatial pooling, specialized for grid-like data such as images.

concepts.name: Deep Learning
concepts.summary: Class of machine learning algorithms that use multiple layers of representation to extract higher-level features from raw input.

concepts.name: Self-Attention Mechanism
concepts.summary: Mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence to compute a contextual representation of the sequence.

concepts.name: Transformer Architecture
concepts.summary: Sequence-to-sequence model relying entirely on self-attention without recurrence or convolutions.

concepts.name: Bidirectional Masked Language Modeling
concepts.summary: Pre-training objective conditioning on both left and right context across all transformer layers simultaneously.

concepts.name: Autoregressive Large Language Models
concepts.summary: Decoder-only generative transformer models scaled to billions of parameters demonstrating emergent in-context few-shot capabilities.

relationships.description: Perceptron developed as foundational algorithmic attempt toward realizing the artificial intelligence agenda.

The representational limitations of single-layer perceptrons, demonstrated by Minsky and Papert, directly influenced the development of multi-layer learning algorithms, leading to the popularization of backpropagation by Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams.
Convolutional neural networks (such as LeNet) use backpropagation and gradient-based learning to train shared spatial convolution kernels directly from input pixels.
GPU-accelerated deep convolutional network (AlexNet) victory at ImageNet 2012 ignited modern deep learning renaissance.
Transformer architecture was introduced by replacing recurrent computation entirely with multi-head self-attention.
Bidirectional language models such as BERT extend the Transformer encoder architecture with masked language pre-training to learn context from both left and right directions simultaneously.
Autoregressive large language models (such as GPT-3) use the causal decoder variant of the Transformer architecture, scaled to massive parameter and token counts.

milestones.title: Publication of Computing Machinery and Intelligence (Turing Test)
milestones.description: Alan Turing proposed the Imitation Game as an operational benchmark for machine intelligence, analyzing philosophical objections and machine learning foundations.

milestones.title: Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence
milestones.description: Conceived by McCarthy, Minsky, Rochester, and Shannon, this workshop coined the term 'Artificial Intelligence' and established AI as an autonomous discipline.

milestones.title: Popularization of Multi-Layer Backpropagation by Rumelhart, Hinton, and Williams
milestones.description: Demonstrated that backpropagation can discover useful internal representations in hidden layers of neural networks, reviving connectionism.

milestones.title: Release of LeNet-5 for Document Recognition
milestones.description: Yann LeCun and colleagues demonstrated practical commercial application of gradient-trained convolutional networks on postal check digits.

milestones.title: AlexNet Dominates ImageNet Competition
milestones.description: AlexNet won the ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge with top-5 error rate of 15.3%, dropping previous error by over 10 percentage points.

milestones.title: Publication of Attention Is All You Need (Transformer)
milestones.description: Google researchers introduced the Transformer model, replacing recurrent networks with multi-head self-attention and unlocking massive sequence parallelization.

milestones.title: Google Releases BERT
milestones.description: Introduced bidirectional pre-training for Transformers, establishing new state-of-the-art results across 11 NLP tasks simultaneously.

milestones.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-3 (Few-Shot Learners)
milestones.description: Demonstrated that scaling autoregressive transformers to 175B parameters enables strong task performance without fine-tuning, via prompt-based in-context learning.

milestones.title: Publication of Latent Diffusion Models (Foundation for Stable Diffusion)
milestones.description: Robin Rombach and collaborators introduced latent diffusion models, moving diffusion training to compressed latent spaces and unlocking scalable high-resolution generative image synthesis.

milestones.title: OpenAI Releases ChatGPT (Democratization of Conversational AI)
milestones.description: OpenAI launched ChatGPT based on GPT-3.5 with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), reaching 100M monthly active users within two months and initiating widespread public adoption.

milestones.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-4 (Multimodal Foundation Model Benchmark)
milestones.description: Demonstrated human-level performance on standardized benchmarks including top-10th percentile bar exam scoring, introducing visual understanding and enhanced reliability.

milestones.title: Meta Releases Llama 2 (Open-Weight Foundation Model Ecosystem)
milestones.description: Meta released Llama 2 with permissive commercial licensing for research and commercial deployment, catalyzing global open-source model adaptation and on-device optimization.

milestones.title: Publication of ISO/IEC 42001 (First Global Standard for AI Management Systems)
milestones.description: The International Organization for Standardization published ISO/IEC 42001, defining international certifiable governance standards for responsible and accountable enterprise AI systems.

milestones.title: Google DeepMind & Isomorphic Labs Unveil AlphaFold 3 in Nature
milestones.description: Introduced diffusion-based joint modeling of proteins, nucleic acids, ligands, and ions, transforming computational biology by predicting all molecule-of-life interactions.

milestones.title: OpenAI Announces GPT-4o (Omni Real-Time Multimodal Interaction)
milestones.description: End-to-end trained omni model processing native audio, vision, and text simultaneously with human-like 232ms voice latency, establishing real-time multimodal assistants.

milestones.title: European Union AI Act Enters Into Force (Comprehensive Global AI Regulation)
milestones.description: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 officially entered into force, establishing the world's first comprehensive risk-categorized legal framework for AI governance and general-purpose models.

milestones.title: OpenAI Releases o1 Reasoning Series (Test-Time Compute Scaling)
milestones.description: Pioneered deliberate test-time compute scaling using reinforcement learning chain-of-thought, demonstrating competitive programming performance and PhD-level physics benchmark accuracy.

milestones.title: DeepSeek Releases DeepSeek-R1 (Open-Weight Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning)
milestones.description: Demonstrated frontier-tier reasoning capabilities using pure reinforcement learning without supervised warm-up (R1-Zero) and multi-head latent attention, releasing weights under open license.

milestones.title: Paris AI Action Summit Concludes with 60+ Nation Global Accord
milestones.description: Global leaders and researchers adopted the Statement on Inclusive and Sustainable AI, establishing international cooperation benchmarks for computing access, safety standards, and public AI infrastructure.

milestones.title: EU AI Act General Prohibitions and GPAI Governance Standards Become Legally Enforceable
milestones.description: The European AI Office initiated legal enforcement of Article 5 prohibited practices and baseline governance codes of practice for systemic general-purpose AI providers across EU member states.
